STAY SAFE GUYS!! There’s a new virus going around, it messes with your head and makes you think all POC are dangerous, I think they’re calling it racism or something... 
#BlackLivesMatter 
#RacismIsAVirus

For everyone in the South Asian community I went to HS with. I just went through my FB messenger messages JUST FROM SENIOR YEAR and the N WORD was used 58 times and 2 times with a hard R. ITS NOT A TERM OF INDEARMENT and this group has let people know it’s okay to use it. #BLM

Our township seems to think this is white vs black people issue, when in reality I have witnessed more usage of the N Word and microagressions by brown and Asian people than by white people. Wake the fuck up. And acknowledge all your AP kids that use this word for fun. #BLM

It’s sad to say but the reality is that in highschool the N word is used as a term of friendship and is considered to be slang. There’s a culture in the brown community of this generation specifically built around saying shit like this. It needs to change #BLM

And while I understand people can change, and learn what they have said was wrong in the past (me included) if you have not publicly apologized for your mistakes in the past, you’re telling the world you haven’t changed and still think it’s okay to say things like the N-word #BLM

We all make mistakes and grow, especially our generation we’ve witnessed so much. But that is no excuse to just say “it’s apart of HS, it’s just locker room talk” because you are acknowledging and letting people know it’s never going to change. #BLM

As I have admitted (publicly and privately) I’ve made mistakes and said things I’m disgusted by and ashamed of but that is NO EXCUSE for the fact that I felt it was even okay to say these things in the first place. This has become and culture and it needs to change #BLM
